objective: Preregister three signal-card specifications for the signed high-frequency news-return feature (Jiang-Li-Wang) before the main session runs any of them: NHF01 ranks on the raw daily news_return, NHF02 ranks on a trailing 5-session sum of news_return (zero-filled on non-news sessions), NHF03 is an event-mode test on large positive reactions only (the long-only analog of the paper's decile 10). All three are long-only (direction +1) and use the admission rule already preregistered in reports/research/signal-cards/library-v1-manifest.json, unchanged. No signal card is run by this iteration.

parameters.rationale: signed high-frequency news-return, one-week primary horizon matching the paper's own holding period (Jiang-Li-Wang 2019/2021); long-only, distinct from the refuted count-based dir:news_attention_features

parameters.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT symbol, trade_date, news_return FROM read_parquet('data/features/news_hf_reaction/*.parquet')), cal AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol, trade_date FROM read_parquet('data/features/daily_broad/*.parquet')), dense AS (SELECT cal.symbol, cal.trade_date, COALESCE(r.news_return, 0) AS news_return FROM cal LEFT JOIN r USING (symbol, trade_date)) SELECT symbol, trade_date, SUM(news_return) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value FROM dense
parameters.rationale: tests whether accumulated signed reaction over the paper's own one-week holding window carries more (or less) information than a single day's reaction; zero-filled on non-news sessions using the PIT daily_broad calendar so the sum is a true trailing-5-trading-day window, not 5 sparse news rows

parameters.threshold_basis: 90th percentile of news_return over the 2025-06 real-data validation build (10,073 stock-days, 3,279 symbols), fixed before any signal-card result exists; a data-grounded, disclosed choice, not tuned after seeing forward returns
parameters.rationale: long-only analog of the paper's decile-10 winner portfolio: does a large signed positive HF reaction alone (event, not rank) predict next-week drift

data_v1_news_packets_and_sip_minute_news.source: Alpaca/Benzinga news (~685k articles, effective coverage 2024-01-01+) + Alpaca SIP 1-minute bars (2023+, confirmed already split-adjusted)
data_v1_news_packets_and_sip_minute_news.hygiene: articles with 0 or >10 symbols dropped (MAX_SYMBOL_FANOUT, reused from news_attention.py); price anchors forward-filled within a session from the last available 1-minute bar

feature_v1_news_hf_reaction_m26_interval.definition: per (symbol, trade_date): 26 intervals (1 overnight, 4pm close(t-1) to 9:45am(t); 25 intraday 15-minute intervals 9:45am-4pm(t)); news_return = compounded product of intervals containing >=1 attributed article; non_news_return = compounded product of the rest; overall_return = (1+news_return)(1+non_news_return)-1, verified exact on the 2025-06 validation build

label_v1_signal_card_next_open_forward_r.definition: signal_card.py's own forward_returns(): formation at the close of trade_date, entry at the next session's open, forward returns at h=1/5/20/60 sessions

validation_v1_signal_card_full_sample_an.full_sample: whatever years of data/features/news_hf_reaction exist at run time (2024-2026 target)
validation_v1_signal_card_full_sample_an.placebos: signal_card.py's own within-day shuffle (rank mode) or redated-event (event mode) placebos, reused unchanged

benchmark_v1_signal_card_library_v1_admi.rank_rule: stable_years AND beats_shuffle AND (T1 or T2 top-30 book positive excess at 20bp in both full and 2024+ windows) AND max |t_nonoverlap| >= 2.5 with the preregistered sign
benchmark_v1_signal_card_library_v1_admi.event_long_rule: beats_redated AND t_dates >= 3 at the primary horizon AND calendar-time book positive excess at 20bp in the full and 2024+ windows
